Factor the numerator and denominator:
\[
\frac{x^2+x-2}{x^2-1}=\frac{(x+2)(x-1)}{(x-1)(x+1)}=\frac{x+2}{x+1}\quad (x\ne 1).
\]
Therefore,
\[
\lim_{x\to1}\frac{x^2+x-2}{x^2-1}=\frac{1+2}{1+1}=\boxed{\frac32}.
\]
